name: Munster (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Munster (a blue dragon below a sword on white).
history: At the request of the municipal council of 18 April 1967 the Regierungspräsident in Lüneburg ordered on 17 May 1967 that the field of the arms granted in 1937 be changed from gold to silver.

features.role: Munster arms — dragon and sword on white
